name: reverseport
description: Reverse engineer anything. Port it anywhere. One MCP server for agents: recon any project, exported game, binary or website (even without files), decompile and trace native, .NET, Android, Electron and web targets with evidence, write clean-room rebuild specs, and port games and code between Godot, Unity, Unreal, three.js and languages with verified parity.

engine.title: Deep-analysis engine
engine.description: Run the published engine through npx (downloaded once) so decompilation, Android, .NET, Electron and browser tools work in the plugin. Off: ReversePort's own tools only.

tool_profile.title: Tool list size
tool_profile.description: compact (small models or contexts), standard, or full (every engine tool listed). Agents can also switch with set_tool_profile.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Where ReversePort keeps extracted packs, port plans, reports and saved big results. Empty: ~/.reverseport.

ghidra_install_dir.title: Ghidra installation (optional)
ghidra_install_dir.description: Your own Ghidra folder for native decompilation. Empty: none or found by setup.
